audit_items.proof_trace: ObligationOwnerCap has key, store but lacks copy ability, making duplication impossible at the Move language level. The sole constructor obligation::new (public(package)) atomically creates one fresh Obligation and exactly one cap whose obligation_id is set to object::id(&obligation), a freshly generated UID — there is no API to supply an arbitrary obligation_id or create a second cap for an existing obligation. The only non-test caller is enter_market_inner, and table::add in handle_new_obligation provides defense-in-depth by aborting on duplicate obligation IDs.
